claim.text: The Microsoft COUPDAYBS page specifies frequency values 1, 2, and 4, basis values 0 through 4, integer truncation for all arguments, and a #NUM! error for frequencies outside 1, 2, or 4.
claim.subject_definition: The COUPDAYBS worksheet function in Excel for Microsoft 365 desktop

source.excerpt: The COUPDAYBS documentation lists 1 for annual, 2 for semiannual, and 4 for quarterly frequency; maps basis 0/omitted through 4 to the five day-count conventions; states that all arguments are truncated to integers; and states that any other frequency returns #NUM!.
source.subject_definition: The COUPDAYBS worksheet function in Excel for Microsoft 365 desktop
source.scope: Official Microsoft Support COUPDAYBS page retrieved 2026-09-24: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/functions/coupdaybs-function . The Formula Atlas candidate spec is catalog/formulas.json semantic_specs.COUPDAYBS.
